tools.name: search_discs
tools.description: Search and filter disc golf discs by text query, brand, category, speed/glide range, stability score range, flight tag, and canonical flight class. Returns up to 50 bounded results with stable IDs and canonical URLs.

tools.name: get_disc
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive details for a specific disc by numeric ID or string slug, including flight ratings, stability score, flight class, flight tag, available plastics, and current market rank.

tools.name: compare_discs
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 discs side-by-side, computing exact flight rating deltas and stability spread relative to the primary baseline disc.

tools.name: find_similar_discs
tools.description: Find alternative replacement discs matching a target disc's category, speed, and flight profile based on weighted Euclidean flight distance.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List and filter disc golf manufacturers/brands in the database, including active mold counts, speed ranges, category breakdowns, and top popular molds.

tools.name: get_flight_matrix
tools.description: Generate a 2D Speed vs Stability Flight Grid for any brand, category, or specific speed rating, grouping discs into understable, straight, stable, overstable, and very overstable columns.

tools.name: get_weekly_rankings
tools.description: Retrieve the latest weekly disc golf retail sales rankings (Top 10) and weekly top risers/fallers by region (global, europe, americas, oceania, asia) based on aggregated sales from 40+ worldwide retailers.

tools.name: get_market_movers
tools.description: Retrieve rolling 4-week disc golf market movers including biggest disc risers, fallers, breakout discs entering the top 100, and brand momentum shifts.

tools.name: get_disc_ranking
tools.description: Retrieve a specific disc golf disc's current weekly retail sales rank across regions (Global, Europe, Americas, Oceania, Asia) and its 4-week market momentum status.
